source.author: verg
source.text: Ergo agite, et laetum cuncti celebremus honorem; poscamus ventos; atque haec me sacra quotannis urbe velit posita templis sibi ferre dicatis.
source.text_original: Ergo agite, et laetum cuncti celebremus honorem; / poscamus ventos; atque haec me sacra quotannis / urbe velit posita templis sibi ferre dicatis.
source.text_english: Come then, and let us all celebrate this joyful rite; let us pray for favorable winds; and may he wish me, with the city laid aside, to bring these offerings every year to the temples dedicated to him.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: cui non tantum immortalitatem, uerum etiam uentorum tribuit potestatem: poscamus uentos, atque haec me sacra quotannis urbe uelit posita templis sibi ferre dicatis.
reuse.text_original: cui non tantum immortalitatem, uerum etiam uentorum tribuit potestatem: poscamus uentos, atque haec me sacra quotannis urbe uelit posita templis sibi ferre dicatis.
reuse.text_english: to whom he grants not only immortality, but also power over the winds: let us ask for the winds, and let him wish that every year, after the city has been founded, I should bring these rites to him in temples dedicated by name.
